newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish May M2 money supply up 2.4 pct - cen bank.
newsitem.headline: Finnish May M2 money supply up 2.4 pct - cen bank.

text.p: Finland's M2 money aggregate rose 2.4 percent year-on-year in May after a 1.0 percent rise in April, the Bank of Finland said on Friday.
NOTE: M1 comprises currency in circulation, and cheques, giro and transaction accounts.
M2 comprises M1 and fixed-term and other bank deposits held by the public.
M3 comprises M2 plus outstanding bank certificates of deposit held by the public.
The Bank of Finland has not published targets for the money aggregates, but has said they are among the economic indicators it monitors to quide monetary policy.
